instructions.task: Classify this tweet under a hate-speech annotation policy whose targets are WOMEN and IMMIGRANTS (migrants, refugees, asylum seekers, illegal aliens). Pick the option that best describes the tweet.
notes: Hate means the tweet expresses or endorses hostility against women or immigrants: contempt, dehumanisation, threats, resentment, stigmatising them, or calls to exclude, deport or round them up, either toward the group or toward an individual woman/immigrant because of that identity.

Endorsing anti-immigrant action counts even when phrased as a policy opinion, a bare slogan (#BuildTheWall, send them home, round them up, enforce immigration laws and take away subsidies) or a news-style item promoting the wall or penalties over illegal immigration. Angry resentment that migrants get jobs, benefits or treatment that natives do not, casting illegal immigrants as cheats, accounts of refugees attacking people, and outrage headlines about 'illegal aliens' as rapists/criminals also count. Plain factual reports of an arrest, and stories where immigrants are the victims, do not.

A woman insulted with a gendered slur (calling her a bitch, whore, cunt, skank) or belittled as a woman (e.g. accused of 'playing the rape card'), women referred to generically as bitches/hoes, or slut-shaming a woman, counts as hate, as does a generic slur-bait like 'RT if you're a cunt' or a bare string of gendered slurs. The same slurs or taunts ('pussy', 'cunt', 'hysterical girlie rants') aimed at a man (a referee, a guy, 'bro', a male politician) do not. A slur used as a general insult with no identifiable woman as its target (at the government, at 'everyone'), quoted to criticise it, or used about oneself consensually, is not hate.

Not hate: neutral news, pro-refugee messages, defending border law enforcement without attacking migrants, jokes or insults whose target is not women/immigrants, and slurs that are quoted, reported, objected to, or used as casual slang between friends.
Tweets not in English, or satire mocking anti-immigrant people (e.g. Brexiters), are not hate.
